items.title: What Needs To Be True To Buy QBTS Stock Now?
items.summary: D-Wave Quantum (QBTS) stock has dropped 70.8% over the past year, while the S&P 500 returned 17.4%. Investors continue to pay 353 times sales for the stock, compared with 3.1 times for the index, suggesting they expect far larger sales ahead. For that to happen, D-Wave must ship two annealing quantum computer systems in the fourth quarter and keep moving cloud customers into production use. So how much of D-Wave's 2026 revenue is tied to two fourth-quarter shipments.

items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Just Formed A Special Committee To Explore A Merger
items.summary: Tesla (NasdaqGS:TSLA) and SpaceX have formed special board committees to evaluate a potential merger of the two Musk led companies. Elon Musk is promoting the deal as a way to combine AI, software, chip design, and robotics capabilities under a single corporate structure. The proposed tie up would pool leadership teams, intellectual property, and AI infrastructure across automotive, aerospace, and robotics operations.
